scientific_integrity: Proof and a separate exact finite enumeration are described; no independent validation, publication priority or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only 4-by-4 submatrices of the Walsh character table on F2^d, d>=3, are classified. No assertion for arbitrary Hadamard matrices or larger minors. Previously known d=3,d=4 determinant/orthogonality statistics are expressly credited.
title: Exact four-by-four Walsh minor rank census in every binary dimension
